tags: A flash wall that heals into skin
Ask for a piece and the enquiry fills itself in
features: The flash wall shows each design as it heals on skin, so a visitor can picture it on themselves
“Ask for this piece” fills in the enquiry with the artist, the size and the idea, so the artist can quote from the first message
Each resident's prices and next free week are worked out from today, so nobody asks when they can get in
How booking works and aftercare in five lines, which answers the questions that take up the studio’s phone
name: Marrow & Pin
short: The flash wall turns each stencil into healed skin, and one tap asks for that piece.
long: The flash wall hangs nine stencils like plates in an artist's book: hover or tap one and the skin comes up, the ink runs down and the stencil goes with it. Pin a piece and “Ask for this piece” fills in the enquiry with the artist, size and idea. Then the three residents in type with their next free week, how booking works, aftercare in five lines and a short form.
proves: Your own drawings can be the website, and they can still take the booking.
story: Built for the trades that sell by showing the work: the drawings are the design, so the page had to be made of them rather than of photographs of them.
